purpose: Marketplace vision endpoint on build-rocm-vec with thinking enabled and stable latency.

launch_command_examples.bash: build-rocm-vec/bin/llama-server.exe -m models/Qwen3.5-9B-Q6_K.gguf --mmproj models/Qwen3.5-9B.mmproj-F16.gguf --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8888 -c 12288 --batch-size 2048 --ubatch-size 512 -ngl 99 -t 8 --threads-http 8 -np 1 --spec-type none --cache-type-k q4_0 --cache-type-v q4_0 --cache-ram 8192 --ctx-checkpoints 32 --flash-attn on --image-min-tokens 1024 --image-max-tokens 1024 --chat-template-kwargs '{"enable_thinking":true}' -n 1024
launch_command_examples.powershell: build-rocm-vec/bin/llama-server.exe -m models/Qwen3.5-9B-Q6_K.gguf --mmproj models/Qwen3.5-9B.mmproj-F16.gguf --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8888 -c 12288 --batch-size 2048 --ubatch-size 512 -ngl 99 -t 8 --threads-http 8 -np 1 --spec-type none --cache-type-k q4_0 --cache-type-v q4_0 --cache-ram 8192 --ctx-checkpoints 32 --flash-attn on --image-min-tokens 1024 --image-max-tokens 1024 --chat-template-kwargs '{"enable_thinking":true}' -n 1024

notes: Thinking mode is forced on via chat-template kwargs.
Prompt cache is enabled (cache-ram + ctx-checkpoints) to avoid full prompt re-processing between requests.
Vision quality is preserved with image-min-tokens=image-max-tokens=1024 for grounding-sensitive cases.
Server hard cap -n 1024 prevents runaway long generations that dominated latency in logs.
